display.name: Fellow
display.summary: Searches the signed-in workspace's meetings, transcripts, agendas, and action items.
examples: What decisions came out of yesterday's project meeting?
Find my open action items from this week.
Summarize the transcript from the roadmap review.

connection.note: Before signing in, ask a Fellow workspace admin to enable MCP connections under Workspace Settings > Fellow MCP. Use an account that can see the intended meetings.

agent.name: fellow
agent.description: Reads the meeting notes, transcripts, agendas, action items and channels visible to the signed-in Fellow user. Requires the Fellow workspace admin to enable MCP connections.
agent.owns: You own Fellow meeting context the signed-in user is allowed to see. Search meetings first, then fetch the summary or transcript for a specific meeting. You can read action items and agendas but cannot edit them. Include a source link when Fellow provides one. You do not own other meeting apps.

tool_descriptions.search_meetings: Search meetings by title, notes, transcript, participants, dates, or channel.
tool_descriptions.get_meeting_summary: Fetch the AI-generated summary for a specific meeting.
tool_descriptions.get_meeting_transcript: Fetch a meeting transcript, optionally for a recording or time range.
tool_descriptions.get_meeting_participants: List the participants of a meeting.
tool_descriptions.get_action_items: Search and filter action items by status, assignee, and dates.
tool_descriptions.list_channels: List channels in the signed-in Fellow workspace.
tool_descriptions.get_channel_details: Get the name, description, and type of a Fellow channel.
tool_descriptions.read_agenda: Read the agenda of a meeting.
